assignment.source: Root assignment: optimized-font-1.0/2d-landscape-rotation remaining representatives 41–50 only; preserve earlier attribution.

method: Joined per-identity pixel review. Ten full-resolution existing lossless WebP derivatives were opened with view_image detail=original. Forty-one earlier direct observations remain attributed to /root/review_design from verified immutable saved receipts. All 83 frame files and all 32 exact-byte repeat bindings were independently checked without decoding or reopening prior representatives.
conclusion: Pixel classification complete for all 83 retained source identities: 51 direct observations (41 historical, 10 new), 32 independently bound exact-byte matches, 0 unviewed. New frames show recovered Standard portrait with a complete concealed-hand panel and controls; no new visible layout defect, private card face or Leave dialog. The saved native 2D hand-control clipping and picker-row clipping findings remain attributed to /root/review_design and are not resolved by these Standard portrait frames.

findings.summary: In the ready native 2D table, only the top edge of the lime hand control is visible at the body viewport boundary; its label is below the viewport. The fixed Choose cards to play and Call the bluff controls fit.
findings.source: Preserved /root/review_design observations; not a new pixel inspection by /root/pixel_o1_land2.
findings.limit: This documents clipping at the recorded scroll position. Scrolling or successful activation of the hand control is not demonstrated; recovered Standard portrait frames do not establish a native-layout fix.

findings.summary: A further table-style radio row has only its top visible at the scrolling-content boundary; its label is outside the viewport. Standard table, 2D table and Done are visible.
findings.limit: Does not establish that the clipped option is unreachable by scrolling.

findings.summary: All ten newly viewed representatives show the complete concealed-hand panel, full Show hand control and full muted Select cards control in the centered recovered Standard portrait projection. No private card faces or Leave dialog are visible.
findings.limit: Only the recorded image contents are established; no continuous privacy or control activation claim.

limits: This joins saved /root/review_design direct observations for representatives 0–40 with ten new /root/pixel_o1_land2 direct observations for representatives 41–50. It is not an independent reinspection of earlier pixels.

Every source index retains its own original packet PTS/DTS, timebase, media position and byte identity. Exact encoded-byte matches propagate an attributed direct observation without collapsing source-frame identities.
No host UTC/action/UP clock anchor is inferred. Visible Android clock labels and recording metadata do not supply such an anchor. Packet PTS remain in the original media timebase.
No between-frame or continuous privacy claim, and no proof that a previously exposed hand was concealed. Earlier native views are reported as concealed already; new views also show a concealed hand.

Control labels visible in a still do not prove touch reachability, scrolling, successful activation, input cancellation or event ordering. Native hand-control clipping remains a finding at the recorded scroll position.

The original 1600×720 canvas contains a centered portrait projection in newly viewed frames. Pixel review does not establish native dp/sp sizes, accessibility semantics, physical-device behavior or store qualification.
Only complete main-decoder frame identities 0–82 are classified. Prior interrupted decode artifacts are not counted as extra reviewed identities.

No new decode, capture, build, download, image transformation, repository mutation or other clip pixel review was performed. This receipt is private evidence preparation; it is not a gallery publication.
